billTypes.opening: I present my professional compliments and acknowledge receipt of your application for Fumigation Certification.
billTypes.extra:
Kindly provide the following information as per the fumigation guidelines of Liberia:
1. Name(s) and Qualification(s) of fumigation operator(s)
2. Personal Health Certificate of fumigation Operator(s) from an accredited hospital in Liberia
3. List of fumigants/chemicals
4. List and contacts of past clients (if any)
5. Business registry
6. Fumigation protocol
7. Organizational chart with clear job descriptions
billTypes.billSentence: Please note that the total bill for this certificate is
billTypes.collection: Please come with this letter and the deposit slip, after payment, to the EPA Account section for the issuance of an official receipt and proceed to the ERRS Department for the certificate.
